experiment_data.hypothesis: Merging our 19 statistical features with 11 Binoculars cross-perplexity features (30 total) should reveal whether the two feature sets provide complementary depth signal. If merged RF >80%, the cross-model transfer signal from Binoculars adds value beyond our features (answers reviewer "why not merge?"). If merged RF ≈ 78%, signal is saturated and both feature sets are redundant — depth information ceiling is ~78% on these features.
